versions.changelog: v1.4.0 (2026-10-08): Guard against progressive-disclosure regression. New Execution Model section: this is a methodology-type skill whose core action is judgment (human reasoning, not pre-encodable), so the absent end-to-end script is a design decision, not a gap; metric_probe.py is an optional accelerator (hints only, never grades). Added a main-file line budget (<=215 target / 250 cap) and pushed the artifact-mapping table, metric definitions and exception details down into references/faq.md. Added a which-file-to-read routing table (zh/en). Tightened the requires wording to 'explicitly exempted after assessment' with trip conditions. Removed advertising-law absolute terms ('the only') flagged by the publish gate. FAQ expanded to 9 questions in both languages. Fixed a threshold inconsistency (>2000 vs >500) between FAQ and SKILL.md.

v1.3.0 (2026-10-05): Dual-source optimization driven by SkillHub TRACE eval (4.8/5) + ClawHub SkillSpector scan. Read-only statement made precise (removes 2 Medium declaration-behavior mismatches). New Language Selection (auto/zh/en) with full English artifacts (checklist, samples, FAQ, README). New scripts/metric_probe.py: pure-stdlib metric probe, hints only, never grades. Complex-scenario samples (zh/en), 30-second quick start, large-file segmentation fallback. All artifacts bilingual.

v1.2.0 (2026-09-30): Documentation-only optimization driven by an 8-dimension quality audit (v1.1.1 rated A / 8.80). Adds: ask-for-target-before-audit loop in Audit Flow (D2/D5); new Exceptions & Degradation section (D4); new Input Requirements section clarifying .py/.js/.ts support and no-overwrite behavior (D5); routing hint (D2). Same capability as v1.1.0/v1.1.1: read-only first-principles clean-code audit emitting evidence-backed (file:line) checklist reports.

v1.1.1 (2026-09-28): First-Principles Clean Code Audit — same capability as v1.1.0; aligns version across GitHub/SkillHub/ClawHub. Read-only audit of your WorkBuddy skill scripts / Python code with comprehension-cost & change-risk axes + red/amber/green, emitting evidence-backed (file:line) checklist reports.

v1.1.0: bilingual docs (README/SKILL.md EN), ClawHub hardening (.clawhubignore excludes LICENSE+scripts/), dev tooling in scripts/, skillhub-gate PASS (summary/tags added, no real username, dynamic sanitizer). Multi-platform license: GitHub/SkillHub MIT; ClawHub MIT-0.
